description: FEMA Flood Map Service Center is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by FEMA, Federal Emergency Management Agency. Users can find, view, analyze, and print flood hazard maps from FEMA. This site is the official public source for flood hazard information produced in support of the National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP). Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – General. Assets: Critical Facilities, Property, Transportation and Mobility, Water Infrastructure – Stormwater. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
